verdict.rationale: Abacum's investor-reporting page says that as actuals flow in, the narrative updates and the deck builds itself, with no copy-paste between model, slides and memo. Other pages tie board numbers to the live model and document forecasting and three-statement outputs, so the core of the story is claimed directly. However, the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the board-pack or deck builder (templates, export formats), explicit evidence of variance-commentary generation beyond the 'narrative updates' line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
